prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
A good first call would be **Shere’s Construction & Handyman** for a mix of repairs and remodeling. Its BBB profile lists it as accredited, and its services include kitchen and bathroom updates, drywall, painting, flooring, siding, and deck repairs. Call **(417) 385-8899**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/general-contractor/sheres-construction-handyman-0734-1000009996)

For a larger remodel, **GRC General Construction** is another option: BBB lists it as accredited with an A+ rating, and its profile describes kitchen and bathroom renovations, flooring, and custom carpentry. Call **(417) 499-7424**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/remodel-contractors/grc-general-construction-0734-1000049263)

Before hiring either—or anyone else—get at least three written estimates, ask for recent local references and proof of insurance, and make sure the contract spells out the scope, payment schedule, timeline, and warranty. BBB ratings are one screening signal, not a guarantee of workmanship.
